reason: Verification failed on critical logic defects: calibration reuses a mutable Simulation across trials and evaluation ignores the calibration window, yielding NaN/invalid scores. Micro-transition capture is on by default, risking memory/IO blowups. With one iteration left before the maximum, a final pass focused on these fixes can stabilize calibration and produce valid metrics.

specific_areas: Instantiate a fresh Simulation per calibration/evaluation OR implement and use Simulation.reset() before each trial
Add window-aware evaluation (Simulation.evaluate(..., window)) and slice both simulated and ground-truth series
Harden calibration scoring to handle None/NaN/inf (treat as +inf) to avoid crashes
Default micro-transition capture to off; add flag and/or subsampling; avoid saving micro transitions in IO unless explicitly requested
Apply CLI parameter overrides via ParameterRegistry.set_params() to respect unknown/frozen checks and capture warnings
Clamp parameters to defined bounds when applying updates (ParamsAdapter.apply())
Seed graph/network generation using the configured random_seed for reproducibility
Reduce double state mutation in observation aggregation (ensure single point of commit) if time allows

data_analysis.adjustments: Define and consistently pass the calibration window; ensure ground-truth loading returns series covering the window and document any gaps.

model_planning.adjustments: Plan for stateless evaluation in calibration (fresh Simulation per trial) and a clear separation of compute vs. commit in the observation pipeline; defer non-essential model extensions.

code_generation.adjustments: Implement evaluate(window), refactor evaluate_params()/calibrator to use fresh Simulation or reset(); toggle capture_micro default off with a flag; route CLI overrides through registry.set_params(); clamp parameter updates; seed network generators; gate/suppress micro IO.

code_verification.adjustments: Add checks/tests for: reset/recreate Simulation per trial; evaluation window alignment lengths match; metrics finite; overrides respect frozen/unknown; micro capture disabled by default.

simulation_execution.adjustments: During calibration, create a new Simulation (or call reset()) for each trial; run only over [start:end]; disable micro capture and large IO unless explicitly requested.

result_evaluation.adjustments: Compute metrics on the exact window; guard against None/NaN/inf; report aggregate score and per-metric validity flags.

feedback_generation.adjustments: Surface warnings from registry.set_params(), note any metric exclusions due to missing GT, and summarize resource-saving toggles (micro capture status) in run reports.
